mapper.sql: d.*,p.name AS managing_project_name,u.real_name AS owner_name,u.username AS owner_username, (SELECT MAX(r.revision_no) FROM sop_revision r WHERE r.sop_id=d.id AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AS latest_published_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_revision r WHERE r.sop_id=d.id AND r.status=0 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AS draft_count

SELECT FROM sop_document d JOIN sop_project p ON p.id=d.managing_project_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=d.owner_user_id WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM sop_document WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id,p.code,p.name FROM sop_project p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status IN (0,1) AND (p.owner_user_id=#{actor}OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sop_project_member m WHERE m.project_id=p.id AND m.user_id=#{actor} AND m.access_level=1 AND m.member_status=1)) AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},p.name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},p.code)>0) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM sop_revision WHERE sop_id=#{sopId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY revision_no DESC
SELECT * FROM sop_revision WHERE sop_id=#{sopId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM sop_step WHERE revision_id=#{revisionId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM sop_step WHERE revision_id=#{revisionId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.file_id,a.caption,a.sort_order,f.original_name,f.mime_type,f.file_kind,f.byte_size FROM sop_step_attachment a JOIN sop_file f ON f.id=a.file_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.step_id=#{stepId} ORDER BY a.sort_order,a.id
SELECT id,file_id,caption,sort_order FROM sop_step_attachment WHERE step_id=#{stepId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_no),0)+1 FROM sop_revision WHERE sop_id=#{sopId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_revision WHERE sop_id=#{sopId} AND status=0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_revision WHERE sop_id=#{sopId} AND status IN (1,2)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_project_binding WHERE sop_id=#{sopId})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_subproject_binding WHERE sop_id=#{sopId})

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_project_binding b JOIN sop_project p ON p.id=b.project_id WHERE b.revision_id=#{revisionId} AND b.status=1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status IN (0,1))+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_subproject_binding b JOIN sop_subproject s ON s.id=b.subproject_id JOIN sop_project p ON p.id=s.project_id WHERE b.revision_id=#{revisionId} AND b.status=1 AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status IN (0,1) AND p.status IN (0,1))

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_document WHERE managing_project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_project_binding WHERE project_id=#{projectId})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_subproject_binding b JOIN sop_subproject s ON s.id=b.subproject_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_subproject_binding WHERE subproject_id=#{subprojectId}
